notes.text: A sheet of drawings: four principal upper ovals with two small alternatives; lower triangle/dot, tripod, quadrilateral and triangle with stem; two left ovals plus parenthesized miniature variants; central divided oval; lower quadrilateral with diagonal and spoked triangle; right group of two oval outlines and extended crossing curves beside repeated boundary strokes.

There are four OK-family labels and four ou-family labels. Their actual spellings and local doubts are retained. H’s initial count three is explicitly corrected to four by its own rereading note; the integrated H reading therefore agrees with the visible count.
No independent question mark or prose statement of uncertainty is visible. The unsure markers in reading.tex are editorial qualifications.
The scan carries archive numeral 11 at bottom left. It has no title or date in the main drawing field. No manuscript-page macro is supplied for this archive numeral.

H.tex has text status for this packet. Its drawing description and rereading note are collated. Its terminal unnumbered section Décompositions n-aires (et découpages) d’espaces topologiques and following note expressly locating that wording on feuillet13 remain contextual apparatus and are excluded from scan012.

The original C-D3 table already qualifies the overlaid lower-left oval, although C.tex lacks a local unsure. The proposed local marker carries that same existing doubt. The right group is also locally qualified for live/cancelled state; H’s cancelled reading remains an explicit alternative.

No expression, object assignment or morphism is supplied to identify these unlabeled drawings. The graph shapes, edge multiplicities, rims, fills and drawn directions are transcribed from their strokes. No mathematical computation or theorem check was performed.

Distinct detached traces and points are represented graphically, with hand, role and surface origin left undetermined. Gray paper texture that supplies no stable stroke or character has not been converted into invented writing.

All 68 original C filled contour commands and all 8 original label nodes are retained. The two state-qualified contour clusters are boxed locally without a generic added cancellation stroke. Pale missing continuations and detached marks receive separate explicit paths.

Crop 03 retains the complete targeted large oval and its overlay extensions; adjacent lower miniature outlines continue beyond its lower boundary and are read from half a. Crop 04 retains the entire targeted right group; its right boundary clips only the separate edge dash, whose whole extent is documented from half a.
Validation is structural source inspection only: braces, environments, macro names, path retention, crop references and report/transcription anchors. No compiler or rendering was used.
